page.overview:
Who is Alex Davis?

Alex Davis was a political strategist hired by Thea Queen to serve as Oliver Queen's mayoral campaign manager. Davis suggested that Oliver distance himself from his past relationships, like with Laurel Lance.

Oliver did not want to do this however, with Davis growing angry and saying he'll get paid whether Oliver listens to him or not. Davis expressed interest in pursuing a relationship with Thea, and they planned a date together at the restaurant Gerards.

When Oliver Queen dropped out of the race for mayor, Alex aligned himself with Ruvé Adams, becoming her political advisor. 's mind control pills. 's secret Genesis location under the guise of a vacation, leaving her trapped.

entity.description:
Alex Davis was a political strategist hired by Thea Queen to serve as Oliver Queen's mayoral campaign manager.

Davis suggested that Oliver distance himself from his past relationships, like with Laurel Lance. Oliver did not want to do this however, with Davis growing angry and saying he'll get paid whether Oliver listens to him or not.

Davis expressed interest in pursuing a relationship with Thea, and they planned a date together at the restaurant Gerards.

When Oliver Queen dropped out of the race for mayor, Alex aligned himself with Ruvé Adams, becoming her political advisor. As Ruvé was a member of H.I.V.E., Ruvé supplied Alex with pills in concern for his health, but they were secretly H.I.V.E.'s mind control pills. Under H.I.V.E.'s control, Alex took his girlfriend Thea to H.I.V.E.'s secret Genesis location under the guise of a vacation, leaving her trapped.
